sources: audit/state_park_fees/co_sites_2026-10-12.jsonl + co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl (cpwshop parkID 50039 per-site catalog and 2027-06 rates)

values.note: 76 sites in three loops: A (1-25), B (26-53), C (54-76); ADA sites 44 and 46. Booking-site lengths run 50-70 ft; many pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/ridgway-state-park/ridgway-state-park-camping-lodging ('Dakota Terraces features three camping loops with 76 campsites (Loop A site #'s 1-25, Loop B site #'s 2653, and Loop C site #'s 54-76)'; 'ADA-accessible campsites (Sites 44, 46, 105, and 107)') + cpwshop catalog (Dakota Terraces A/B/C loops: maximum vehicle length 50-70, Driveway Entry Pull-Through and Back-In), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Open all year, but in winter only select plowed sites in Elk Ridge and Dakota Terraces stay open (heated showers and restrooms, shared water hydrants, the year-round dump station). On the booking site the A loop takes reservations through the winter (site 001, Nov 2026-Apr 2027).

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/ridgway-state-park/ridgway-state-park-camping-lodging ('Ridgway State Park offers year-round camping'; 'select campsites in Elk Ridge and Dakota Terraces campgrounds remain open. Enjoy plowed, reservable sites ... heated showers and restroom facilities, and a year-round dump station'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Individual 30-amp electric; shared fill-and-go water hydrants.

hookups.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/ridgway-state-park/ridgway-state-park-camping-lodging (Dutch Charlie Campground: 'Individual 30 amp electrical hook ups', 'Shared water hook-ups (Fill and go water hydrants)', 'RV dump station located above Dakota Terraces campground', 'Flush Restrooms', 'Free showers', 'Coin-operated laundry facilities (summer only)'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Free showers and flush restrooms (heated in winter); coin laundry and vending summer only. RV dump station above Dakota Terraces, open year-round. Visitor center, swim beach, boat ramp and Blue Heron Marina nearby.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/ridgway-state-park/ridgway-state-park-camping-lodging (Dutch Charlie Campground: 'Individual 30 amp electrical hook ups', 'Shared water hook-ups (Fill and go water hydrants)', 'RV dump station located above Dakota Terraces campground', 'Flush Restrooms', 'Free showers', 'Coin-operated laundry facilities (summer only)'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reservation required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; ADA sites by phone only, with a placard. A daily vehicle pass is required as well. Check-in 1 p.m. (no early check-in), check-out noon; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/ridgway-state-park/ridgway-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Ridgway State Park ... online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. ADA designated campsites ... must be reserved by phone'; 'Reservations can be made up to six months in advance of your arrival date'; 'Check-in time for your site is at 1:00 p.m. ... check-out is by 12:00 p.m. (noon)'), read 2026-10-27

note: Campground in the park's Dutch Charlie area above Ridgway Reservoir, with San Juan views; loops A, B and C. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop: confirmed 76 sites, 30-amp electric, shared water only, $36 (2027 June), reservation-only via cpwshop, year-round (winter on select plowed sites). Added max rig 70, pull-through, sewer false, showers/flush toilets/laundry, booking url/window/note.
flags: Site-count conflict: CPW says 76; the cpwshop catalog holds 72 RV sites in loops A-C (A 20, B 27, C 25).
Winter: CPW names no loop; the A loop takes winter reservations on cpwshop (site 001 open Nov 2026-Apr 2027); a B-loop and C-loop site showed unavailable all winter. I did not map every site.
Pin checked: 285 m from the centroid of the 72 cpwshop site coordinates (38.21666,-107.73125).
